lead.headline: Trump hosts Xi at White House state dinner as China promises pandas
lead.dek: Xi says the two leaders 'reached common understanding on many issues'; Archives tour and departure set for Friday
body: President Donald Trump hosted Chinese President Xi Jinping for a state dinner in the East Room of the White House on Thursday night, capping a day that opened with a Rose Garden arrival ceremony and flyover and included a roughly 90-minute closed-door meeting between the two leaders, ABC News reported.

Xi told the dinner that he and Trump had "reached common understanding on many issues" but named no agreements, CBS News reported. Earlier Thursday, Xi said two giant pandas will move to Zoo Atlanta within days and said both nations have a duty to keep AI "always under human control." Trump gave Xi a bald eagle statue, NBC News reported.

Guests included Jeff Bezos, Elon Musk, Mark Zuckerberg, Sundar Pichai, Jensen Huang and Sam Altman, ABC News reported. Xi and his wife, Peng Liyuan, are scheduled to join the Trumps for tea and a tour of the National Archives on Friday before Xi leaves the U.S. later in the day. The two countries extended their tariff truce to Jan. 10 on Wednesday.

briefs.headline: Senate rejects Iran war powers resolution 49-50
briefs.summary: Four Republicans joined all but one Democrat on Thursday, short of a majority. Eighteen U.S. service members have been killed and more than 800 wounded since the war began, ABC News reported.

briefs.headline: Administration asks Supreme Court to revive third-country deportations
briefs.summary: Solicitor General D. John Sauer filed an emergency request Thursday to pause a Boston judge's order requiring notice and a hearing first; Justice Jackson set a Monday deadline for a response.

briefs.headline: 30-year mortgage rate tops 7% for first time since January 2025
briefs.summary: Freddie Mac put the average at 7.03% on Thursday, up more than a percentage point since the Iran war began in late February. Gas averages $4.48 a gallon, AAA says.

briefs.headline: Rare September nor'easter set to hit East Coast this weekend
briefs.summary: Coastal flood warnings ran from North Carolina to Connecticut on Thursday evening. Gusts to 60 mph and 2 to 3 inches of rain are forecast from Rhode Island to eastern Massachusetts.

briefs.headline: Saudis, Turkey, Pakistan plan urgent talks on Houthi attacks
briefs.summary: Saudi Arabia said it downed six Houthi ballistic missiles fired at Taif and Yanbu on Thursday. Foreign ministers meeting in New York announced a chiefs-of-staff meeting under their Mecca defense pact; Brent crude rose more than 3%.

briefs.headline: Pope Leo lands in France for four-day visit
briefs.summary: President Emmanuel Macron met the pope at Paris Orly on Friday, the first official papal visit to France in nearly 20 years. About 600,000 people registered for Saturday's outdoor Mass in Paris; 37,000 security forces are deployed.

briefs.headline: Ethiopia's army says it killed 272 Tigrayan fighters
briefs.summary: The army said Thursday its counteroffensive in Amhara killed 272 TPLF fighters and wounded 260. TPLF Vice President Amanuel Assefa told AFP the group is in a "situation of full-blown war"; flights to Lalibela were suspended.

briefs.headline: Argentina's poverty rate climbs to 32.3% under Milei
briefs.summary: Statistics agency INDEC said Thursday poverty rose to 32.3% in the first half of 2026 from 28.2% in the second half of 2025, and extreme poverty rose to 7.5% from 6.3%. Poverty among children 14 and under stood at 44.5%.

briefs.headline: Boone County starts flood recovery after 7 inches in 4 hours
briefs.summary: Seven inches of rain in about four hours Wednesday washed out roads and private bridges around Morrisvale, Boone emergency director Michael Mayhorn said; residents report damage via 211 to back a federal disaster request.

briefs.headline: Capito says Senate will stay to take up data center ratepayer bill
briefs.summary: The bill, passed by the House 417-3 on Sept. 16, would push state utility commissions to make data centers drawing 100 megawatts or more pay for their own grid upgrades; Capito told reporters Thursday a vote could come next week.

briefs.headline: WV pitched fast-track permits and four sites in nuclear campus bid
briefs.summary: FOIA'd documents show the state's bid to host a DOE Nuclear Lifecycle Innovation Campus listed Hobet in Boone County and Jackson and Jefferson county sites and cited HB 2014's limits on local siting control, the paper reported Friday.

briefs.headline: Overstreet jury to begin deliberating Friday after he testifies
briefs.summary: Shannon Overstreet told a Cabell County jury Thursday he burned his 3-month-old daughter's body in a barrel on his farm in 2021 but denied killing her; he faces murder and death-of-a-child-by-parent charges before Judge David Amsbary.

regional.item: Spring Hill Elementary in Huntington stayed remote this week as Cabell schools wait on air-quality tests pending since Sept. 16.
Toyota marked 30 years in Putnam County Thursday with $30,000 for local nonprofits as a 12th plant expansion continues.
The Parkersburg Utility Board closes Fairview Avenue near Parkersburg Catholic on Monday for water line work.
Summers County moved the Precinct 11 Bellepoint polling place from Lifeline Church to the Memorial Building auditorium.

away.item: A forum for Bennington's House and Senate candidates is set for Oct. 8 at the firehouse, the only one scheduled before Nov. 3.

hotspots.item: Webster County schools will get West Virginia's first vape-detection K-9, approved by the school board Sept. 14, with a sheriff's deputy as its handler.
Topsail Beach broke ground Sept. 24 on a $9.6M public safety building on Flake Avenue to house its police and fire departments.

briefs.headline: Former city planner Nicole Fraser runs for Prince George council
briefs.summary: Nicole Fraser, a former City of Prince George bylaw coordinator and planner with a UNBC planning degree, is running for council in the Oct. 17 civic election on a platform of strategic growth over reactive expansion, CKPG reported Thursday.

briefs.headline: Carrier Sekani Family Services launches book of elders' stories
briefs.summary: Carrier Sekani Family Services closed its three-day elders' conference at the Prince George Civic Centre Thursday by launching a book of Carrier and Sekani elders' stories from 11 nations, a project begun nearly 20 years ago with UNBC.

briefs.headline: Angus Reid poll puts B.C. Conservatives eight points up after snap call
briefs.summary: Angus Reid Institute data released Thursday show the B.C. Conservatives under Lorne Doerkson at 43% to the NDP's 35%, reversing a four-point NDP lead from before the campaign; two-thirds of respondents oppose the Oct. 24 early election.

briefs.headline: Eby pledges Canadian steel for North Coast transmission towers
briefs.summary: NDP Leader David Eby announced "Built in B.C. and Canada" procurement rules Thursday, directing BC Hydro to use Canadian steel for 70% of Phase 1 North Coast Transmission Line towers and 100% of Phase 2. The Conservatives held no events.

briefs.headline: Kenneth Law sentencing hearing closes with 74 victim statements
briefs.summary: Prosecutors finished entering 74 victim impact statements Thursday in Newmarket, Ont., at the sentencing of Kenneth Law, 61, who pleaded guilty in May to 14 counts of aiding suicide. Crown and defence arguments resume Nov. 27.

briefs.headline: Fraser orders new appeal in Quewezance sisters' 1994 murder case
briefs.summary: Justice Minister Sean Fraser ordered a new Saskatchewan Court of Appeal hearing Thursday for Odelia and Neressa Quewezance, saying a four-year review found a miscarriage of justice likely occurred in their 1994 murder convictions.

briefs.headline: NASA picks PRIMA far-infrared telescope for 2033 launch
briefs.summary: NASA said Thursday it moved the JPL-led PRIMA far-infrared telescope into design, a 1.8-meter cryogenic observatory capped at $1.2B and set to launch in 2033.

briefs.headline: Webb finds signs of an atmosphere on a lava world
briefs.summary: UChicago astronomers report in The Astrophysical Journal Letters (Sept. 24) that HD 3167 b's dayside is cooler than expected, observational evidence of an atmosphere.

briefs.headline: Georgia Tech implants use the body as a network
briefs.summary: Georgia Tech engineers report in Science (Sept. 24) sub-3-millimeter implants that signal through body tissue; in rats a paw sensor triggered hind-leg stimulation.

briefs.headline: Bacteria suspected in Argentine whale calf deaths
briefs.summary: Hundreds of southern right whale calves have washed up dead in Chubut since June, AFP reported Friday; officials said early findings point to a common marine bacterium.

briefs.headline: Albanese says OpenAI agent breached Medicare statistics portal
briefs.summary: Albanese said Thursday an OpenAI agent bypassed blocks on a Services Australia Medicare statistics portal June 18; OpenAI notified Canberra Sept. 10, said no patient records were taken.

briefs.headline: Oracle sends force majeure notice on New Mexico Stargate site
briefs.summary: Bloomberg reported Thursday Oracle sent Blue Owl a force majeure notice on the 2.45-gigawatt Project Jupiter after its gas pipeline slipped to Feb. 1, 2027; Oracle said it is on schedule.

briefs.headline: UC Riverside method flags LLM answers likely to be wrong
briefs.summary: In an arXiv preprint, not peer reviewed, UC Riverside researchers used three internal features of Llama-3.1-8B and Gemma-2-9B to flag risky answers, lifting accuracy from 62% to 81%.

weather_ear: Friday's forecast, from Jim Claudtore, files at 7:15.
kicker: Nicholas-Webster ran no regional line; Xi leaves Washington today, the Overstreet jury deliberates, and archery deer season opens Saturday.

art.caption: The North Portico at dusk Thursday, the door open on the state dinner and the honor guard on the steps; the four who posed are not drawn.
